review:
Hip-hop bling on six Megaways reels – gold chains, cars and boomboxes, with up to seven symbols per reel and tumbles.

Wilds are the centre of the game: where they land decides what happens. A wild on reel two can add more wilds, on reel five it can add mystery symbols to the middle reels, and wilds on reels three and four can trigger free spins. 96.02% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
